title: Auth0 Who Am I MCP
name: auth0-whoami-mcp
author: AkxenTech
description: An Auth0 Custom Extension MCP server that reports the authenticated caller.

AUTH0_TENANT_ORIGIN.description: Absolute Auth0 tenant origin, for example https://tenant.us.auth0.com.

MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Exact public HTTPS URL of this extension's /mcp endpoint. This is also the required Auth0 access-token audience.

MCP_RESOURCE_METADATA_URL.description: Optional reachable protected-resource metadata URL. Defaults to the extension-scoped /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp path.
